title: The small promises people build their work around
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: Make the promise clear — Name the result, timing, and boundary.; Expose the dependency — Show what another person is waiting for.; Update before surprise — Share changes while options remain.; Close or renegotiate — Confirm completion, cancellation, or a new plan..
